description: A ground-level photograph depicting an olive grove in a mountainous area, identified by the surrounding document text as being in South-western Spain. The image features multiple rows of cultivated olive trees with characteristic green-grey foliage, planted in a structured, linear pattern that recedes into the distance. The ground in the foreground and between the rows of trees consists of dry, light brown soil with sparse, dry vegetation, indicative of a warm, Mediterranean, or semi-arid agricultural environment. Undulating hills or mountains are visible in the distant background under a clear, hazy sky. The photograph is credited to M. Palacios, and serves as an example for the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) CORINE Land Cover (CLC) class 2.2.2 (Olive groves).
